lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Environment (climate change, greenhouse gases, emissions, renewable energy, fossil fuels, waste, pollution, sustainable, endangered).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: Climate change is making summers hotter.
Cars and factories produce greenhouse gases.
We need to cut carbon emissions.
Coal and oil are fossil fuels.
Wind and solar are renewable energy sources.
We produce too much plastic waste.
Air pollution is a serious problem.
The jaguar is an endangered species.
A long drought destroyed the crops.
Most of our rubbish ends up in a landfill.

items: **reduce / cut** emissions, waste, your carbon footprint
**switch to** renewable energy; **run out of** resources
"The pollutions in this city are terrible." **Pollution** e **waste** são incontáveis: **The pollution is terrible.**
"We must protect the nature." Para a natureza em geral, sem artigo: **We must protect nature.**
"Ecology problems are increasing." Ecology é o estudo científico. Para problemas do meio ambiente, use **environmental problems.**
"The climate change is a threat." Sem artigo: **Climate change is a threat.**

acc: The pollution in this city is terrible

lessons.title: Future continuous e future perfect
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Future continuous (will be + -ing) e future perfect (will have + particípio).

head: Forma
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Lisbon.
By 2040 the city will have cut its emissions.
In June she will have been working here for ten years.

items: **Future continuous:** uma ação em andamento num momento do futuro. *At 8 pm I'll be driving to the airport.*
**Future perfect:** uma ação que já estará terminada até um momento do futuro. Costuma vir com **by** e **by the time**. *By the time you arrive, I'll have finished.*
**Future perfect continuous:** enfatiza a duração até aquele momento. *By May we'll have been living here for a year.*
**Perguntas educadas** sobre planos: *Will you be using the car tonight?* soa mais gentil que *Are you going to use the car?*
"At 8 pm I will be work." Depois de **will be** vai o verbo com -ing: **I will be working.**
"By the time you arrive, I will finish the report." Se já estará pronto, use **I will have finished.**
"She will have been work here for ten years." O certo é **will have been working.**
"By 2050 we will reduce emissions" parece uma decisão. Para dizer que já estará feito até 2050, use **we will have reduced.**

exercises.prompt: This time tomorrow I ___ (fly) to Lisbon.
By 2040 the city ___ (reduce) its emissions by half.
By the time you arrive, the meeting ___ (finish).
Don't call me at nine. I ___ (drive) to the airport.
At 8 pm I will be work.
acc: At 8 pm I will be working

exercises.prompt: By the time you arrive, I will finish the report.
acc: By the time you arrive, I will have finished the report
By the time you arrive, I'll have finished the report

exercises.prompt: She will have been work here for ten years in June.
acc: She will have been working here for ten years in June
she'll have been working here for ten years in June

lessons.title: Inglês prático, discutir prós e contras
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Discutir prós e contras.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Let's look at the pros and cons. / There are two sides to this.
One advantage is that... / The main benefit is... / It would save us money.
The main drawback is... / One disadvantage is that... / The downside is the cost.
On the one hand, it is cheaper. On the other hand, it takes longer.
I'm in favour of... / I'm not convinced that... / It depends on...
That's a fair point, but... / I see what you mean, however...
All things considered, I think it's worth it. / On balance, I'd say yes.

items: "I am agree with you." Agree é verbo: **I agree with you.**
"It is depend of the price." O certo é **It depends on the price.**
"In my opinion, I think that..." é repetido. Use **In my opinion, ...** ou **I think that...**
